projects.title: Udhyog Saathi
projects.subtitle: Business Operating System for Manufacturers
projects.shortDescription: A specialized SaaS platform engineered for small and mid-sized manufacturing enterprises, centralizing dual-mode invoicing, raw-material inventory, worker operations, and real-time production analytics.
projects.cardDescription: Turning traditional manufacturing into a digital system.
projects.overview: Small and mid-sized manufacturers in India often manage mission-critical operations with fragmented paper slips, physical ledgers, and informal WhatsApp chats. Udhyog Saathi replaces disjointed tracking with a single intuitive operational workspace.
projects.problem: Manual double-entry errors in invoicing, sudden stockouts of raw materials without warning, lack of worker attendance and payout accountability, and zero visibility into daily production output.
projects.solution: A full-stack web operating system designed specifically around Indian manufacturing workflows—including support for Kacha and Pakka bill formats, real-time inventory threshold alerts, and mobile-friendly workforce dashboards.
features: Executive operational dashboard summarizing active orders, revenue, and material levels
Dual-mode invoice generation supporting flexible business compliance requirements
Real-time raw material and finished inventory tracking with automated stock warnings
Worker management module for tracking shifts, task completions, and wage disbursements
Production line throughput analytics to uncover bottleneck operations

architecture.description: Decoupled React client communicating with a resilient Express REST service backed by MongoDB document stores for dynamic invoice schemas.

projects.myContribution: Architected the frontend UI with React and Tailwind CSS, structured the operational data models in MongoDB, built RESTful endpoints in Express, and designed the intuitive invoice and inventory creation flows.
outcomes: Eliminated manual paper ledgers across regional manufacturing plants.
Prevented production halts with automatic stock threshold warnings.
Reduced invoice preparation time from 15 minutes to under 2 minutes.

projects.title: InsightLoop
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Business Intelligence Platform
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack operational intelligence platform tracking multi-stream sales, worker payouts, and profit-and-loss margins via a synchronized live dashboard and integrated AI assistant.
projects.cardDescription: Real-time business intelligence and multi-stream analytics.
projects.overview: InsightLoop is an operational command center built to turn high-velocity transactional data into clear business decisions, providing operators with immediate clarity into their cash position and team performance.
projects.problem: Business owners frequently spend hours each evening compiling disparate receipts and cash transactions to calculate whether they made a profit or loss on any given day.
projects.solution: A reactive dashboard that automatically syncs sales entries and worker payments across devices in real time using WebSockets, presenting dynamic profitability calculations and instant trend graphs.
features: Auto-updating operational dashboard with zero page reloads via WebSockets
Granular sales, expense, and worker payment ledger with filterable date ranges
Live net profit and loss margin calculation engine
Integrated conversational AI assistant to answer natural language queries about metrics
Role-aware access control protecting confidential business financials
projects.myContribution: Built the entire application from ground up: React frontend interface, Node/Express REST backend, MongoDB schemas, WebSocket bidirectional communication channels, and AI assistance integration.
outcomes: Real-time WebSocket synchronization across client terminals.
Automated daily profit and loss calculations.
Conversational AI assistant answering natural language financial queries.

projects.title: Parallel
projects.subtitle: A Social Platform for Shared Interests
projects.shortDescription: A modern social platform for shared interests, discussions, and collaborative community spaces.
projects.overview: Parallel is an interest-first community platform designed to replace noisy algorithmic timelines with topic-focused spaces where members can organize discussions, share work, and collaborate.
projects.problem: Modern social feeds prioritize viral sensationalism over thoughtful group discussion, making it difficult for niche communities to hold focused conversations.
projects.solution: A structured workspace with topic-based channels, real-time message broadcasting, rich media sharing, and member reputation signals.
features: Topic-segmented interest channels with real-time WebSocket communication
Rich markdown posting and snippet sharing for developer and creator communities
Member roles, direct messaging, and community moderation toolsets
Responsive, distraction-free UI optimized for both desktop and mobile
projects.myContribution: Designed the frontend interface and interaction flows, implemented WebSocket chat listeners, and structured channel data models.
outcomes: Low-latency real-time discussion rooms with WebSocket integration.
Topic-isolated channel architecture preventing feed pollution.

projects.title: HotReload
projects.subtitle: Go CLI File Watcher Tool
projects.shortDescription: A lightweight, compiled command-line utility built in Go that monitors source code changes recursively, applies debouncing, and triggers automatic server rebuilds and graceful process restarts.
projects.cardDescription: Zero-dependency file watcher and process runner in Go.
projects.overview: Developed to eliminate the friction of manually terminating, recompiling, and restarting backend services during active development, HotReload provides rapid feedback loops for developers in any language ecosystem.
projects.problem: Developers working with compiled languages or custom server scripts lose momentum when constantly switching to terminal windows to kill old processes and run new builds manually.
projects.solution: A self-contained Go CLI binary that listens to operating system filesystem events, debounces rapid multi-file writes, and reliably manages the child process lifecycle with graceful signal propagation.
features: Recursive filesystem tree watching powered by the low-level fsnotify library
Configurable event debouncing window to eliminate multiple restart cycles during IDE saves
Automatic project stack detection and smart build command inferences
Graceful process termination handling (SIGTERM / SIGKILL) to prevent zombie port locks
Zero external runtime dependencies; compiled directly into a single cross-platform executable
projects.myContribution: Authored the complete Go CLI architecture: created separate modular packages for filesystem watching, process execution, stack detection, and user configuration flags.
outcomes: Lightweight single binary distribution requiring zero dependencies.
Debounced file watching eliminating redundant multi-rebuild cycles.

projects.title: Personal Finance Tracker
projects.subtitle: Track Expenses, Plan Better
projects.shortDescription: A streamlined financial dashboard for logging assets, categorizing recurring liabilities, and visualizing net worth trajectory over time with interactive Chart.js summaries.
projects.cardDescription: Private financial clarity without ads or intrusive banking sync.
projects.overview: A private, privacy-conscious finance tracking tool built to consolidate fragmented bank statements, credit obligations, and investments into a single unified visual dashboard.
projects.problem: Commercial finance apps are often cluttered with advertisements, upsells, and privacy-invasive banking integrations that break frequently.
projects.solution: A lightweight Flask and MongoDB application providing lightning-fast data entry, custom categorization, and dynamic Chart.js visualizations.
features: Comprehensive asset and liability tracking with net worth calculations
Categorized monthly expenditure breakdowns and budget comparisons
Interactive graphical trends powered by Chart.js
Exportable data summaries for personal record keeping
projects.myContribution: Developed the Flask backend API, designed MongoDB document collections, and implemented interactive front-end charts using vanilla JavaScript and Chart.js.
outcomes: Fast local tracking of expenses with granular category filters.
Dynamic net-worth projections and asset ratio visualization.
